_meta.description: schema.org 完整 Type/class 階層（不含列舉值實例，如 ActiveActionStatus 這類 enumerationtype 底下的具體值）。作為實體型別擴充庫，供核心 11 類（core/constants.py::ENTITY_TYPES，見 Brinkmann et al. 2023）比對不上時的較大備援池，不直接放入 LLM prompt。

types.label: 3DModel
types.comment: A 3D model represents some kind of 3D content, which may have encodings in one or more MediaObjects. Many 3D formats are available (e.g. see Wikipedia); specific encoding formats can be represented using the encodingFormat property applied to the relevant MediaObject. For the case of a single file p

types.label: AMRadioChannel
types.comment: A radio channel that uses AM.

types.label: APIReference
types.comment: Reference documentation for application programming interfaces (APIs).

types.label: AboutPage
types.comment: Web page type: About page.

types.label: AcceptAction
types.comment: The act of committing to/adopting an object. Related actions: RejectAction: The antonym of AcceptAction.

types.label: Accommodation
types.comment: An accommodation is a place that can accommodate human beings, e.g. a hotel room, a camping pitch, or a meeting room. Many accommodations are for overnight stays, but this is not a mandatory requirement. For more specific types of accommodations not defined in schema.org, one can use additionalType

types.label: AccountingService
types.comment: Accountancy business. As a LocalBusiness it can be described as a provider of one or more Service(s).

types.label: AchieveAction
types.comment: The act of accomplishing something via previous efforts. It is an instantaneous action rather than an ongoing process.

types.label: Action
types.comment: An action performed by a direct agent and indirect participants upon a direct object. Optionally happens at a location with the help of an inanimate instrument. The execution of the action may produce a result. Specific action sub-type documentation specifies the exact expectation of each argument/r

types.label: ActionAccessSpecification
types.comment: A set of requirements that must be fulfilled in order to perform an Action.

types.label: ActionStatusType
types.comment: The status of an Action.

types.label: ActivateAction
types.comment: The act of starting or activating a device or application (e.g. starting a timer or turning on a flashlight).

types.label: AddAction
types.comment: The act of editing by adding an object to a collection.

types.label: AdministrativeArea
types.comment: A geographical region, typically under the jurisdiction of a particular government.

types.label: AdultEntertainment
types.comment: An adult entertainment establishment.

types.label: AdultOrientedEnumeration
types.comment: Enumeration of considerations that make a product relevant or potentially restricted for adults only.

types.label: AdvertiserContentArticle
types.comment: An Article that an external entity has paid to place or to produce to its specifications. Includes advertorials, sponsored content, native advertising and other paid content.

types.label: AggregateOffer
types.comment: When a single product is associated with multiple offers (for example, the same pair of shoes is offered by different merchants), then AggregateOffer can be used. Note: AggregateOffers are normally expected to associate multiple offers that all share the same defined businessFunction value, or defau

types.label: AggregateRating
types.comment: The average rating based on multiple ratings or reviews.

types.label: AgreeAction
types.comment: The act of expressing a consistency of opinion with the object. An agent agrees to/about an object (a proposition, topic or theme) with participants.

types.label: Airline
types.comment: An organization that provides flights for passengers.

types.label: Airport
types.comment: An airport.

types.label: AlignmentObject
types.comment: An intangible item that describes an alignment between a learning resource and a node in an educational framework. Should not be used where the nature of the alignment can be described using a simple property, for example to express that a resource teaches or assesses a competency.

types.label: AllocateAction
types.comment: The act of organizing tasks/objects/events by associating resources to it.

types.label: AmpStory
types.comment: A creative work with a visual storytelling format intended to be viewed online, particularly on mobile devices.

types.label: AmusementPark
types.comment: An amusement park.

types.label: AnalysisNewsArticle
types.comment: An AnalysisNewsArticle is a NewsArticle that, while based on factual reporting, incorporates the expertise of the author/producer, offering interpretations and conclusions.

types.label: AnatomicalStructure
types.comment: Any part of the human body, typically a component of an anatomical system. Organs, tissues, and cells are all anatomical structures.

types.label: AnatomicalSystem
types.comment: An anatomical system is a group of anatomical structures that work together to perform a certain task. Anatomical systems, such as organ systems, are one organizing principle of anatomy, and can include circulatory, digestive, endocrine, integumentary, immune, lymphatic, muscular, nervous, reproduct

types.label: AnimalShelter
types.comment: Animal shelter.

types.label: Answer
types.comment: An answer offered to a question; perhaps correct, perhaps opinionated or wrong.

types.label: Apartment
types.comment: An apartment (in American English) or flat (in British English) is a self-contained housing unit (a type of residential real estate) that occupies only part of a building (source: Wikipedia, the free encyclopedia, see http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Apartment).

types.label: ApartmentComplex
types.comment: Residence type: Apartment complex.

types.label: AppendAction
types.comment: The act of inserting at the end if an ordered collection.

types.label: ApplyAction
types.comment: The act of registering to an organization/service without the guarantee to receive it. Related actions: RegisterAction: Unlike RegisterAction, ApplyAction has no guarantees that the application will be accepted.

types.label: ApprovedIndication
types.comment: An indication for a medical therapy that has been formally specified or approved by a regulatory body that regulates use of the therapy; for example, the US FDA approves indications for most drugs in the US.

types.label: Aquarium
types.comment: Aquarium.

types.label: ArchiveComponent
types.comment: An intangible type to be applied to any archive content, carrying with it a set of properties required to describe archival items and collections.

types.label: ArchiveOrganization
types.comment: An organization with archival holdings. An organization which keeps and preserves archival material and typically makes it accessible to the public.

types.label: ArriveAction
types.comment: The act of arriving at a place. An agent arrives at a destination from a fromLocation, optionally with participants.

types.label: ArtGallery
types.comment: An art gallery.

types.label: Artery
types.comment: A type of blood vessel that specifically carries blood away from the heart.

types.label: Article
types.comment: An article, such as a news article or piece of investigative report. Newspapers and magazines have articles of many different types and this is intended to cover them all. See also blog post.

types.label: AskAction
types.comment: The act of posing a question / favor to someone. Related actions: ReplyAction: Appears generally as a response to AskAction.

types.label: AskPublicNewsArticle
types.comment: A NewsArticle expressing an open call by a NewsMediaOrganization asking the public for input, insights, clarifications, anecdotes, documentation, etc., on an issue, for reporting purposes.

types.label: AssessAction
types.comment: The act of forming one's opinion, reaction or sentiment.

types.label: AssignAction
types.comment: The act of allocating an action/event/task to some destination (someone or something).

types.label: Atlas
types.comment: A collection or bound volume of maps, charts, plates or tables, physical or in media form illustrating any subject.

types.label: Attorney
types.comment: Professional service: Attorney. This type is deprecated - LegalService is more inclusive and less ambiguous.

types.label: Audience
types.comment: Intended audience for an item, i.e. the group for whom the item was created.

types.label: AudioObject
types.comment: An audio file.

types.label: AudioObjectSnapshot
types.comment: A specific and exact (byte-for-byte) version of an AudioObject. Two byte-for-byte identical files, for the purposes of this type, considered identical. If they have different embedded metadata the files will differ. Different external facts about the files, e.g. creator or dateCreated that aren't re

types.label: Audiobook
types.comment: An audiobook.

types.label: AuthenticateAction
types.comment: The action of authenticating into a device or application.

types.label: AuthorizeAction
types.comment: The act of granting permission to an object.

types.label: AutoBodyShop
types.comment: Auto body shop.

types.label: AutoDealer
types.comment: An car dealership.

types.label: AutoPartsStore
types.comment: An auto parts store.

types.label: AutoRental
types.comment: A car rental business.

types.label: AutoRepair
types.comment: Car repair business.

types.label: AutoWash
types.comment: A car wash business.

types.label: AutomatedTeller
types.comment: ATM/cash machine.

types.label: AutomotiveBusiness
types.comment: Car repair, sales, or parts.

types.label: BackgroundNewsArticle
types.comment: A NewsArticle providing historical context, definition and detail on a specific topic (aka "explainer" or "backgrounder"). For example, an in-depth article or frequently-asked-questions (FAQ) document on topics such as Climate Change or the European Union. Other kinds of background material from a n

types.label: Bakery
types.comment: A bakery.

types.label: BankAccount
types.comment: A product or service offered by a bank whereby one may deposit, withdraw or transfer money and in some cases be paid interest.

types.label: BankOrCreditUnion
types.comment: Bank or credit union.

types.label: BarOrPub
types.comment: A bar or pub.

types.label: Barcode
types.comment: An image of a visual machine-readable code such as a barcode or QR code.

types.label: Beach
types.comment: Beach.

types.label: BeautySalon
types.comment: Beauty salon.

types.label: BedAndBreakfast
types.comment: Bed and breakfast. See also the dedicated document on the use of schema.org for marking up hotels and other forms of accommodations.

types.label: BedDetails
types.comment: An entity holding detailed information about the available bed types, e.g. the quantity of twin beds for a hotel room. For the single case of just one bed of a certain type, you can use bed directly with a text. See also BedType (under development).

types.label: BedType
types.comment: A type of bed. This is used for indicating the bed or beds available in an accommodation.

types.label: BefriendAction
types.comment: The act of forming a personal connection with someone (object) mutually/bidirectionally/symmetrically. Related actions: FollowAction: Unlike FollowAction, BefriendAction implies that the connection is reciprocal.

types.label: BikeStore
types.comment: A bike store.

types.label: BioChemEntity
types.comment: Any biological, chemical, or biochemical thing. For example: a protein; a gene; a chemical; a synthetic chemical.

types.label: Blog
types.comment: A blog, sometimes known as a "weblog". Note that the individual posts (BlogPostings) in a Blog are often colloquially referred to by the same term.

types.label: BlogPosting
types.comment: A blog post.

types.label: BloodTest
types.comment: A medical test performed on a sample of a patient's blood.

types.label: BoardingPolicyType
types.comment: A type of boarding policy used by an airline.

types.label: BoatReservation
types.comment: A reservation for boat travel. Note: This type is for information about actual reservations, e.g. in confirmation emails or HTML pages with individual confirmations of reservations. For offers of tickets, use Offer.

types.label: BoatTerminal
types.comment: A terminal for boats, ships, and other water vessels.

types.label: BoatTrip
types.comment: A trip on a commercial ferry line.

types.label: BodyMeasurementTypeEnumeration
types.comment: Enumerates types (or dimensions) of a person's body measurements, for example for fitting of clothes.

types.label: BodyOfWater
types.comment: A body of water, such as a sea, ocean, or lake.

types.label: Bone
types.comment: Rigid connective tissue that comprises up the skeletal structure of the human body.

types.label: Book
types.comment: A book.

types.label: BookFormatType
types.comment: The publication format of the book.

types.label: BookSeries
types.comment: A series of books. Included books can be indicated with the hasPart property.

types.label: BookStore
types.comment: A bookstore.

types.label: BookmarkAction
types.comment: An agent bookmarks/flags/labels/tags/marks an object.

types.label: Boolean
types.comment: Boolean: True or False.

types.label: BorrowAction
types.comment: The act of obtaining an object under an agreement to return it at a later date. Reciprocal of LendAction. Related actions: LendAction: Reciprocal of BorrowAction.

types.label: BowlingAlley
types.comment: A bowling alley.

types.label: BrainStructure
types.comment: Any anatomical structure which pertains to the soft nervous tissue functioning as the coordinating center of sensation and intellectual and nervous activity.

types.label: Brand
types.comment: A brand is a name used by an organization or business person for labeling a product, product group, or similar.

types.label: BreadcrumbList
types.comment: A BreadcrumbList is an ItemList consisting of a chain of linked Web pages, typically described using at least their URL and their name, and typically ending with the current page. The position property is used to reconstruct the order of the items in a BreadcrumbList. The convention is that a breadc

types.label: Brewery
types.comment: Brewery.

types.label: Bridge
types.comment: A bridge.

types.label: BroadcastChannel
types.comment: A unique instance of a BroadcastService on a CableOrSatelliteService lineup.

types.label: BroadcastEvent
types.comment: An over the air or online broadcast event.

types.label: BroadcastFrequencySpecification
types.comment: The frequency in MHz and the modulation used for a particular BroadcastService.

types.label: BroadcastService
types.comment: A delivery service through which content is provided via broadcast over the air or online.

types.label: BrokerageAccount
types.comment: An account that allows an investor to deposit funds and place investment orders with a licensed broker or brokerage firm.

types.label: BuddhistTemple
types.comment: A Buddhist temple.

types.label: BusOrCoach
types.comment: A bus (also omnibus or autobus) is a road vehicle designed to carry passengers. Coaches are luxury buses, usually in service for long distance travel.

types.label: BusReservation
types.comment: A reservation for bus travel. Note: This type is for information about actual reservations, e.g. in confirmation emails or HTML pages with individual confirmations of reservations. For offers of tickets, use Offer.

types.label: BusStation
types.comment: A bus station.

types.label: BusStop
types.comment: A bus stop.

types.label: BusTrip
types.comment: A trip on a commercial bus line.

types.label: BusinessAudience
types.comment: A set of characteristics belonging to businesses, e.g. who compose an item's target audience.

types.label: BusinessEntityType
types.comment: A business entity type is a conceptual entity representing the legal form, the size, the main line of business, the position in the value chain, or any combination thereof, of an organization or business person. Commonly used values: http://purl.org/goodrelations/v1#Business http://purl.org/goodrela

types.label: BusinessEvent
types.comment: Event type: Business event.

types.label: BusinessFunction
types.comment: The business function specifies the type of activity or access (i.e., the bundle of rights) offered by the organization or business person through the offer. Typical are sell, rental or lease, maintenance or repair, manufacture / produce, recycle / dispose, engineering / construction, or installatio

types.label: BuyAction
types.comment: The act of giving money to a seller in exchange for goods or services rendered. An agent buys an object, product, or service from a seller for a price. Reciprocal of SellAction.

types.label: CDCPMDRecord
types.comment: A CDCPMDRecord is a data structure representing a record in a CDC tabular data format used for hospital data reporting. See documentation for details, and the linked CDC materials for authoritative definitions used as the source here.

types.label: CableOrSatelliteService
types.comment: A service which provides access to media programming like TV or radio. Access may be via cable or satellite.

types.label: CafeOrCoffeeShop
types.comment: A cafe or coffee shop.

types.label: Campground
types.comment: A camping site, campsite, or Campground is a place used for overnight stay in the outdoors, typically containing individual CampingPitch locations. In British English a campsite is an area, usually divided into a number of pitches, where people can camp overnight using tents or camper vans or carava

types.label: CampingPitch
types.comment: A CampingPitch is an individual place for overnight stay in the outdoors, typically being part of a larger camping site, or Campground. In British English a campsite, or campground, is an area, usually divided into a number of pitches, where people can camp overnight using tents or camper vans or ca

types.label: Canal
types.comment: A canal, like the Panama Canal.

types.label: CancelAction
types.comment: The act of asserting that a future event/action is no longer going to happen. Related actions: ConfirmAction: The antonym of CancelAction.

types.label: Car
types.comment: A car is a wheeled, self-powered motor vehicle used for transportation.

types.label: CarUsageType
types.comment: A value indicating a special usage of a car, e.g. commercial rental, driving school, or as a taxi.

types.label: Casino
types.comment: A casino.

types.label: CategoryCode
types.comment: A Category Code.

types.label: CategoryCodeSet
types.comment: A set of Category Code values.

types.label: CatholicChurch
types.comment: A Catholic church.

types.label: Cemetery
types.comment: A graveyard.

types.label: Certification
types.comment: A Certification is an official and authoritative statement about a subject, for example a product, service, person, or organization. A certification is typically issued by an indendent certification body, for example a professional organization or government. It formally attests certain characterist

types.label: CertificationStatusEnumeration
types.comment: Enumerates the different statuses of a Certification (Active and Inactive).

types.label: Chapter
types.comment: One of the sections into which a book is divided. A chapter usually has a section number or a name.

types.label: CheckAction
types.comment: An agent inspects, determines, investigates, inquires, or examines an object's accuracy, quality, condition, or state.

types.label: CheckInAction
types.comment: The act of an agent communicating (service provider, social media, etc) their arrival by registering/confirming for a previously reserved service (e.g. flight check-in) or at a place (e.g. hotel), possibly resulting in a result (boarding pass, etc). Related actions: CheckOutAction: The antonym of Ch

types.label: CheckOutAction
types.comment: The act of an agent communicating (service provider, social media, etc) their departure of a previously reserved service (e.g. flight check-in) or place (e.g. hotel). Related actions: CheckInAction: The antonym of CheckOutAction. DepartAction: Unlike DepartAction, CheckOutAction implies that the age

types.label: CheckoutPage
types.comment: Web page type: Checkout page.

types.label: ChemicalSubstance
types.comment: A chemical substance is 'a portion of matter of constant composition, composed of molecular entities of the same type or of different types' (source: ChEBI:59999).

types.label: ChildCare
types.comment: A Childcare center.

types.label: ChildrensEvent
types.comment: Event type: Children's event.

types.label: ChooseAction
types.comment: The act of expressing a preference from a set of options or a large or unbounded set of choices/options.

types.label: Church
types.comment: A church.

types.label: City
types.comment: A city or town.

types.label: CityHall
types.comment: A city hall.

types.label: CivicStructure
types.comment: A public structure, such as a town hall or concert hall.

types.label: Claim
types.comment: A Claim in Schema.org represents a specific, factually-oriented claim that could be the itemReviewed in a ClaimReview. The content of a claim can be summarized with the text property. Variations on well known claims can have their common identity indicated via sameAs links, and summarized with a nam

types.label: ClaimReview
types.comment: A fact-checking review of claims made (or reported) in some creative work (referenced via itemReviewed).

types.label: Class
types.comment: A class, also often called a 'Type'; equivalent to rdfs:Class.

types.label: Clip
types.comment: A short TV or radio program or a segment/part of a program.

types.label: ClothingStore
types.comment: A clothing store.

types.label: Code
types.comment: Computer programming source code. Example: Full (compile ready) solutions, code snippet samples, scripts, templates.

types.label: Collection
types.comment: A collection of items, e.g. creative works or products.

types.label: CollectionPage
types.comment: Web page type: Collection page.

types.label: CollegeOrUniversity
types.comment: A college, university, or other third-level educational institution.

types.label: ComedyClub
types.comment: A comedy club.

types.label: ComedyEvent
types.comment: Event type: Comedy event.

types.label: ComicCoverArt
types.comment: The artwork on the cover of a comic.

types.label: ComicIssue
types.comment: Individual comic issues are serially published as part of a larger series. For the sake of consistency, even one-shot issues belong to a series comprised of a single issue. All comic issues can be uniquely identified by: the combination of the name and volume number of the series to which the issue

types.label: ComicSeries
types.comment: A sequential publication of comic stories under a unifying title, for example "The Amazing Spider-Man" or "Groo the Wanderer".

types.label: ComicStory
types.comment: The term "story" is any indivisible, re-printable unit of a comic, including the interior stories, covers, and backmatter. Most comics have at least two stories: a cover (ComicCoverArt) and an interior story.

types.label: Comment
types.comment: A comment on an item - for example, a comment on a blog post. The comment's content is expressed via the text property, and its topic via about, properties shared with all CreativeWorks.

types.label: CommentAction
types.comment: The act of generating a comment about a subject.

types.label: CommunicateAction
types.comment: The act of conveying information to another person via a communication medium (instrument) such as speech, email, or telephone conversation.

types.label: CompleteDataFeed
types.comment: A CompleteDataFeed is a DataFeed whose standard representation includes content for every item currently in the feed. This is the equivalent of Atom's element as defined in Feed Paging and Archiving RFC 5005, for example (and as defined for Atom), when using data from a feed that represents a collec

types.label: CompoundPriceSpecification
types.comment: A compound price specification is one that bundles multiple prices that all apply in combination for different dimensions of consumption. Use the name property of the attached unit price specification for indicating the dimension of a price component (e.g. "electricity" or "final cleaning").

types.label: ComputerLanguage
types.comment: This type covers computer programming languages such as Scheme and Lisp, as well as other language-like computer representations. Natural languages are best represented with the Language type.

types.label: ComputerStore
types.comment: A computer store.

types.label: ConferenceEvent
types.comment: Event type: Conference event.

types.label: ConfirmAction
types.comment: The act of notifying someone that a future event/action is going to happen as expected. Related actions: CancelAction: The antonym of ConfirmAction.

types.label: Consortium
types.comment: A Consortium is a membership Organization whose members are typically Organizations.

types.label: ConstraintNode
types.comment: The ConstraintNode type is provided to support usecases in which a node in a structured data graph is described with properties which appear to describe a single entity, but are being used in a situation where they serve a more abstract purpose. A ConstraintNode can be described using constraintProp

types.label: ConsumeAction
types.comment: The act of ingesting information/resources/food.

types.label: ContactPage
types.comment: Web page type: Contact page.

types.label: ContactPoint
types.comment: A contact point—for example, a Customer Complaints department.

types.label: ContactPointOption
types.comment: Enumerated options related to a ContactPoint.

types.label: Continent
types.comment: One of the continents (for example, Europe or Africa).

types.label: ControlAction
types.comment: An agent controls a device or application.

types.label: ConvenienceStore
types.comment: A convenience store.

types.label: Conversation
types.comment: One or more messages between organizations or people on a particular topic. Individual messages can be linked to the conversation with isPartOf or hasPart properties.

types.label: CookAction
types.comment: The act of producing/preparing food.

types.label: Cooperative
types.comment: An organization that is a joint project of multiple organizations or persons.

types.label: Corporation
types.comment: Organization: A business corporation.

types.label: CorrectionComment
types.comment: A comment that corrects CreativeWork.

types.label: Country
types.comment: A country.

types.label: Course
types.comment: A description of an educational course which may be offered as distinct instances which take place at different times or take place at different locations, or be offered through different media or modes of study. An educational course is a sequence of one or more educational events and/or creative w

types.label: CourseInstance
types.comment: An instance of a Course which is distinct from other instances because it is offered at a different time or location or through different media or modes of study or to a specific section of students.

types.label: Courthouse
types.comment: A courthouse.

types.label: CoverArt
types.comment: The artwork on the outer surface of a CreativeWork.

types.label: CovidTestingFacility
types.comment: A CovidTestingFacility is a MedicalClinic where testing for the COVID-19 Coronavirus disease is available. If the facility is being made available from an established Pharmacy, Hotel, or other non-medical organization, multiple types can be listed. This makes it easier to re-use existing schema.org

types.label: CreateAction
types.comment: The act of deliberately creating/producing/generating/building a result out of the agent.

types.label: CreativeWork
types.comment: The most generic kind of creative work, including books, movies, photographs, software programs, etc.

types.label: CreativeWorkSeason
types.comment: A media season, e.g. TV, radio, video game etc.

types.label: CreativeWorkSeries
types.comment: A CreativeWorkSeries in schema.org is a group of related items, typically but not necessarily of the same kind. CreativeWorkSeries are usually organized into some order, often chronological. Unlike ItemList which is a general purpose data structure for lists of things, the emphasis with CreativeWork

types.label: Credential
types.comment: A credential is a certificate that is used to verify the identity of a person or entity.

types.label: CreditCard
types.comment: A card payment method of a particular brand or name. Used to mark up a particular payment method and/or the financial product/service that supplies the card account. Commonly used values: http://purl.org/goodrelations/v1#AmericanExpress http://purl.org/goodrelations/v1#DinersClub http://purl.org/goo

types.label: Crematorium
types.comment: A crematorium.

types.label: CriticReview
types.comment: A CriticReview is a more specialized form of Review written or published by a source that is recognized for its reviewing activities. These can include online columns, travel and food guides, TV and radio shows, blogs and other independent Web sites. CriticReviews are typically more in-depth and pro

types.label: CssSelectorType
types.comment: Text representing a CSS selector.

types.label: CurrencyConversionService
types.comment: A service to convert funds from one currency to another currency.

types.label: DDxElement
types.comment: An alternative, closely-related condition typically considered later in the differential diagnosis process along with the signs that are used to distinguish it.

types.label: DENonprofitType
types.comment: DENonprofitType: Non-profit organization type originating from Germany in accordance with article 52 of the German fiscal code (Abgabenverordnung or AO).

types.label: DanceEvent
types.comment: Event type: A social dance.

types.label: DanceGroup
types.comment: A dance group—for example, the Alvin Ailey Dance Theater or Riverdance.

types.label: DataCatalog
types.comment: A collection of datasets.

types.label: DataDownload
types.comment: All or part of a Dataset in downloadable form.

types.label: DataFeed
types.comment: A single feed providing structured information about one or more entities or topics.

types.label: DataFeedItem
types.comment: A single item within a larger data feed.

types.label: DataType
types.comment: The basic data types such as Integers, Strings, etc.

types.label: Dataset
types.comment: A body of structured information describing some topic(s) of interest.

types.label: Date
types.comment: A date value in ISO 8601 date format.

types.label: DateTime
types.comment: A combination of date and time of day in the form [-]CCYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ss[Z|(+|-)hh:mm] (see Chapter 5.4 of ISO 8601).

types.label: DatedMoneySpecification
types.comment: A DatedMoneySpecification represents monetary values with optional start and end dates. For example, this could represent an employee's salary over a specific period of time. Note: This type has been superseded by MonetaryAmount, use of that type is recommended.

types.label: DayOfWeek
types.comment: The day of the week, e.g. used to specify to which day the opening hours of an OpeningHoursSpecification refer. Originally, URLs from GoodRelations were used (for Monday, Tuesday, Wednesday, Thursday, Friday, Saturday, Sunday plus a special entry for PublicHolidays); these have now been integrated d

types.label: DaySpa
types.comment: A day spa.

types.label: DeactivateAction
types.comment: The act of stopping or deactivating a device or application (e.g. stopping a timer or turning off a flashlight).

types.label: DefenceEstablishment
types.comment: A defence establishment, such as an army or navy base.

types.label: DefinedRegion
types.comment: A DefinedRegion is a geographic area defined by potentially arbitrary (rather than political, administrative or natural geographical) criteria. Properties are provided for defining a region by reference to sets of postal codes. Examples: a delivery destination when shopping. Region where regional pr

types.label: DefinedTerm
types.comment: A word, name, acronym, phrase, etc. with a formal definition. types.comment: The price for the delivery of an offer using a particular delivery method.

types.comment: A demand entity represents the public, not necessarily binding, not necessarily exclusive, announcement by an organization or person to seek a certain type of goods or services. For describing demand using this type, the very same properties used for Offer apply.

types.label: Dentist

types.comment: The act of departing from a place. An agent departs from a fromLocation for a destination, optionally with participants.

types.label: DrawAction

types.comment: The act of swallowing liquids.

types.label: DriveWheelConfigurationValue
types.comment: A value indicating which roadwheels will receive torque.

types.label: DrugStrength
types.comment: A specific strength in which a medical drug is available in a specific country.

types.label: DryCleaningOrLaundry
types.comment: A dry-cleaning business.

types.label: Duration
types.comment: Quantity: Duration (use ISO 8601 duration format).

types.label: EUEnergyEfficiencyEnumeration

types.label: EatAction

types.comment: An EducationalAudience.

types.comment: Event type: Food event.

types.label: FoodService
types.comment: A food service, like breakfast, lunch, or dinner.

types.comment: The Game type represents things which are games. These are typically rule-governed recreational activities, e.g. role-playing games in which players assume the role of characters in a fictional setting.

types.label: GameAvailabilityEnumeration
types.comment: For a VideoGame, such as used with a PlayGameAction, an enumeration of the kind of game availability offered.

types.comment: Indicates whether this game is multi-player, co-op or single-player.

types.label: GeneralContractor
types.comment: A general contractor.

types.comment: (Eventually to be defined as) a supertype of GeoShape designed to accommodate definitions from Geo-Spatial best practices.

types.comment: For a given health insurance plan, the specification for costs and coverage of prescription drugs.

types.comment: A home goods store.

types.comment: A hospital.

types.comment: A hostel - cheap accommodation, often in shared dormitories. See also the dedicated document on the use of schema.org for marking up hotels and other forms of accommodations.

types.comment: A hotel is an establishment that provides lodging paid on a short-term basis (source: Wikipedia, the free encyclopedia, see http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Hotel). See also the dedicated document on the use of schema.org for marking up hotels and other forms of accommodations.

types.comment: A hotel room is a single room in a hotel. See also the dedicated document on the use of schema.org for marking up hotels and other forms of accommodations.

types.comment: A house is a building or structure that has the ability to be occupied for habitation by humans or other creatures (source: Wikipedia, the free encyclopedia, see http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/House).

types.label: HousePainter

types.comment: Instructions that explain how to achieve a result by performing a sequence of steps.

types.comment: An item used as either a tool or supply when performing the instructions for how to achieve a result.

types.comment: A supply consumed when performing the instructions for how to achieve a result.

types.comment: An explanation in the instructions for how to achieve a result. It provides supplementary information about a technique, supply, author's preference, etc. It can explain what could be done, or what should not be done, but doesn't specify what should be done (see HowToDirection).

types.comment: A tool used (but not consumed) when performing instructions for how to achieve a result.

types.comment: A legal document such as an act, decree, bill, etc. (enforceable or not) or a component of a legal act (like an article).

types.comment: A specific object or file containing a Legislation. Note that the same Legislation can be published in multiple files. For example, a digitally signed PDF, a plain PDF and an HTML version.

types.label: LegislativeBuilding
types.comment: A legislative building—for example, the state capitol.

types.label: LendAction
types.comment: The act of providing an object under an agreement that it will be returned at a later date. Reciprocal of BorrowAction. Related actions: BorrowAction: Reciprocal of LendAction.

types.label: Library
types.comment: A library.

types.label: LibrarySystem
types.comment: A LibrarySystem is a collaborative system amongst several libraries.

types.label: LifestyleModification
types.comment: A process of care involving exercise, changes to diet, fitness routines, and other lifestyle changes aimed at improving a health condition.

types.label: Ligament
types.comment: A short band of tough, flexible, fibrous connective tissue that functions to connect multiple bones, cartilages, and structurally support joints.

types.label: LikeAction
types.comment: The act of expressing a positive sentiment about the object. An agent likes an object (a proposition, topic or theme) with participants.

types.label: LinkRole
types.comment: A Role that represents a Web link, e.g. as expressed via the 'url' property. Its linkRelationship property can indicate URL-based and plain textual link types, e.g. those in IANA link registry or others such as 'amphtml'. This structure provides a placeholder where details from HTML's link element c

types.label: LiquorStore
types.comment: A shop that sells alcoholic drinks such as wine, beer, whisky and other spirits.

types.label: ListItem
types.comment: An list item, e.g. a step in a checklist or how-to description.

types.label: ListenAction
types.comment: The act of consuming audio content.

types.label: LiteraryEvent
types.comment: Event type: Literary event.

types.label: LiveBlogPosting
types.comment: A LiveBlogPosting is a BlogPosting intended to provide a rolling textual coverage of an ongoing event through continuous updates.

types.label: LoanOrCredit
types.comment: A financial product for the loaning of an amount of money, or line of credit, under agreed terms and charges.

types.label: LocalBusiness
types.comment: A particular physical business or branch of an organization. Examples of LocalBusiness include a restaurant, a particular branch of a restaurant chain, a branch of a bank, a medical practice, a club, a bowling alley, etc.

types.label: LocationFeatureSpecification
types.comment: Specifies a location feature by providing a structured value representing a feature of an accommodation as a property-value pair of varying degrees of formality.

types.label: Locksmith
types.comment: A locksmith.

types.label: LodgingBusiness
types.comment: A lodging business, such as a motel, hotel, or inn.

types.label: LodgingReservation
types.comment: A reservation for lodging at a hotel, motel, inn, etc. Note: This type is for information about actual reservations, e.g. in confirmation emails or HTML pages with individual confirmations of reservations.

types.label: LoginAction
types.comment: The action of logging into a device or application.

types.label: LoseAction
types.comment: The act of being defeated in a competitive activity.

types.label: LymphaticVessel
types.comment: A type of blood vessel that specifically carries lymph fluid unidirectionally toward the heart.

types.label: Manuscript
types.comment: A book, document, or piece of music written by hand rather than typed or printed.

types.label: Map
types.comment: A map.

types.label: MapCategoryType
types.comment: An enumeration of several kinds of Map.

types.label: MarryAction
types.comment: The act of marrying a person.

types.label: Mass
types.comment: Properties that take Mass as values are of the form '<Number> <Mass unit of measure>'. E.g., '7 kg'.

types.label: MathSolver
types.comment: A math solver which is capable of solving a subset of mathematical problems.

types.label: MaximumDoseSchedule
types.comment: The maximum dosing schedule considered safe for a drug or supplement as recommended by an authority or by the drug/supplement's manufacturer. Capture the recommending authority in the recognizingAuthority property of MedicalEntity.

types.label: MeasurementMethodEnum
types.comment: Enumeration(s) for use with measurementMethod.

types.label: MeasurementTypeEnumeration
types.comment: Enumeration of common measurement types (or dimensions), for example "chest" for a person, "inseam" for pants, "gauge" for screws, or "wheel" for bicycles.

types.label: MediaEnumeration
types.comment: MediaEnumeration enumerations are lists of codes, labels etc. useful for describing media objects. They may be reflections of externally developed lists, or created at schema.org, or a combination.

types.label: MediaGallery
types.comment: Web page type: Media gallery page. A mixed-media page that can contain media such as images, videos, and other multimedia.

types.label: MediaManipulationRatingEnumeration
types.comment: Codes for use with the mediaAuthenticityCategory property, indicating the authenticity of a media object (in the context of how it was published or shared). In general these codes are not mutually exclusive, although some combinations (such as 'original' versus 'transformed', 'edited' and 'staged')

types.label: MediaObject
types.comment: A media object, such as an image, video, audio, or text object embedded in a web page or a downloadable dataset i.e. DataDownload. Note that a creative work may have many media objects associated with it on the same web page. For example, a page about a single song (MusicRecording) may have a music

types.label: MediaReview
types.comment: A MediaReview is a more specialized form of Review dedicated to the evaluation of media content online, typically in the context of fact-checking and misinformation. For more general reviews of media in the broader sense, use UserReview, CriticReview or other Review types. This definition is a work

types.label: MediaReviewItem
types.comment: Represents an item or group of closely related items treated as a unit for the sake of evaluation in a MediaReview. Authorship etc. apply to the items rather than to the curation/grouping or reviewing party.

types.label: MediaSubscription
types.comment: A subscription which allows a user to access media including audio, video, books, etc.

types.label: MedicalAudience
types.comment: Target audiences for medical web pages.

types.label: MedicalAudienceType
types.comment: Target audiences types for medical web pages. Enumerated type.

types.label: MedicalBusiness
types.comment: A particular physical or virtual business of an organization for medical purposes. Examples of MedicalBusiness include different businesses run by health professionals.

types.label: MedicalCause
types.comment: The causative agent(s) that are responsible for the pathophysiologic process that eventually results in a medical condition, symptom or sign. In this schema, unless otherwise specified this is meant to be the proximate cause of the medical condition, symptom or sign. The proximate cause is defined a

types.label: MedicalClinic
types.comment: A facility, often associated with a hospital or medical school, that is devoted to the specific diagnosis and/or healthcare. Previously limited to outpatients but with evolution it may be open to inpatients as well.

types.label: MedicalCode
types.comment: A code for a medical entity.

types.label: MedicalCondition
types.comment: Any condition of the human body that affects the normal functioning of a person, whether physically or mentally. Includes diseases, injuries, disabilities, disorders, syndromes, etc.

types.label: MedicalConditionStage
types.comment: A stage of a medical condition, such as 'Stage IIIa'.

types.label: MedicalContraindication
types.comment: A condition or factor that serves as a reason to withhold a certain medical therapy. Contraindications can be absolute (there are no reasonable circumstances for undertaking a course of action) or relative (the patient is at higher risk of complications, but these risks may be outweighed by other co

types.label: MedicalDevice
types.comment: Any object used in a medical capacity, such as to diagnose or treat a patient.

types.label: MedicalDevicePurpose
types.comment: Categories of medical devices, organized by the purpose or intended use of the device.

types.label: MedicalEntity
types.comment: The most generic type of entity related to health and the practice of medicine.

types.label: MedicalEnumeration
types.comment: Enumerations related to health and the practice of medicine: A concept that is used to attribute a quality to another concept, as a qualifier, a collection of items or a listing of all of the elements of a set in medicine practice.

types.label: MedicalEvidenceLevel
types.comment: Level of evidence for a medical guideline. Enumerated type.

types.label: MedicalGuideline
types.comment: Any recommendation made by a standard society (e.g. ACC/AHA) or consensus statement that denotes how to diagnose and treat a particular condition. Note: this type should be used to tag the actual guideline recommendation; if the guideline recommendation occurs in a larger scholarly article, use Medi

types.label: MedicalGuidelineContraindication
types.comment: A guideline contraindication that designates a process as harmful and where quality of the data supporting the contraindication is sound.

types.label: MedicalGuidelineRecommendation
types.comment: A guideline recommendation that is regarded as efficacious and where quality of the data supporting the recommendation is sound.

types.label: MedicalImagingTechnique
types.comment: Any medical imaging modality typically used for diagnostic purposes. Enumerated type.

types.label: MedicalIndication
types.comment: A condition or factor that indicates use of a medical therapy, including signs, symptoms, risk factors, anatomical states, etc.

types.label: MedicalIntangible
types.comment: A utility class that serves as the umbrella for a number of 'intangible' things in the medical space.

types.label: MedicalObservationalStudy
types.comment: An observational study is a type of medical study that attempts to infer the possible effect of a treatment through observation of a cohort of subjects over a period of time. In an observational study, the assignment of subjects into treatment groups versus control groups is outside the control of t

types.label: MedicalObservationalStudyDesign
types.comment: Design models for observational medical studies. Enumerated type.

types.label: MedicalOrganization
types.comment: A medical organization (physical or not), such as hospital, institution or clinic.

types.label: MedicalProcedure
types.comment: A process of care used in either a diagnostic, therapeutic, preventive or palliative capacity that relies on invasive (surgical), non-invasive, or other techniques.

types.label: MedicalProcedureType
types.comment: An enumeration that describes different types of medical procedures.

types.label: MedicalRiskCalculator
types.comment: A complex mathematical calculation requiring an online calculator, used to assess prognosis. Note: use the url property of Thing to record any URLs for online calculators.

types.label: MedicalRiskEstimator
types.comment: Any rule set or interactive tool for estimating the risk of developing a complication or condition.

types.label: MedicalRiskFactor
types.comment: A risk factor is anything that increases a person's likelihood of developing or contracting a disease, medical condition, or complication.

types.label: MedicalRiskScore
types.comment: A simple system that adds up the number of risk factors to yield a score that is associated with prognosis, e.g. CHAD score, TIMI risk score.

types.label: MedicalScholarlyArticle
types.comment: A scholarly article in the medical domain.

types.label: MedicalSign
types.comment: Any physical manifestation of a person's medical condition discoverable by objective diagnostic tests or physical examination.

types.label: MedicalSignOrSymptom
types.comment: Any feature associated or not with a medical condition. In medicine a symptom is generally subjective while a sign is objective.

types.label: MedicalSpecialty
types.comment: Any specific branch of medical science or practice. Medical specialities include clinical specialties that pertain to particular organ systems and their respective disease states, as well as allied health specialties. Enumerated type.

types.label: MedicalStudy
types.comment: A medical study is an umbrella type covering all kinds of research studies relating to human medicine or health, including observational studies and interventional trials and registries, randomized, controlled or not. When the specific type of study is known, use one of the extensions of this type,

types.label: MedicalStudyStatus
types.comment: The status of a medical study. Enumerated type.

types.label: MedicalSymptom
types.comment: Any complaint sensed and expressed by the patient (therefore defined as subjective) like stomachache, lower-back pain, or fatigue.

types.label: MedicalTest
types.comment: Any medical test, typically performed for diagnostic purposes.

types.label: MedicalTestPanel
types.comment: Any collection of tests commonly ordered together.

types.label: MedicalTherapy
types.comment: Any medical intervention designed to prevent, treat, and cure human diseases and medical conditions, including both curative and palliative therapies. Medical therapies are typically processes of care relying upon pharmacotherapy, behavioral therapy, supportive therapy (with fluid or nutrition for e

types.label: MedicalTrial
types.comment: A medical trial is a type of medical study that uses a scientific process to compare the safety and efficacy of medical therapies or medical procedures. In general, medical trials are controlled and subjects are allocated at random to the different treatment and/or control groups.

types.label: MedicalTrialDesign
types.comment: Design models for medical trials. Enumerated type.

types.label: MedicalWebPage
types.comment: A web page that provides medical information.

types.label: MedicineSystem
types.comment: Systems of medical practice.

types.label: MeetingRoom
types.comment: A meeting room, conference room, or conference hall is a room provided for singular events such as business conferences and meetings (source: Wikipedia, the free encyclopedia, see http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Conference_hall). See also the dedicated document on the use of schema.org for marking up h

types.label: MemberProgram
types.comment: A MemberProgram defines a loyalty (or membership) program that provides its members with certain benefits, for example better pricing, free shipping or returns, or the ability to earn loyalty points. Member programs may have multiple tiers, for example silver and gold members, each with different be

types.label: MemberProgramTier
types.comment: A MemberProgramTier specifies a tier under a loyalty (member) program, for example "gold".

types.label: MensClothingStore
types.comment: A men's clothing store.

types.label: Menu
types.comment: A structured representation of food or drink items available from a FoodEstablishment.

types.label: MenuItem
types.comment: A food or drink item listed in a menu or menu section.

types.label: MenuSection
types.comment: A sub-grouping of food or drink items in a menu. E.g. courses (such as 'Dinner', 'Breakfast', etc.), specific type of dishes (such as 'Meat', 'Vegan', 'Drinks', etc.), or some other classification made by the menu provider.

types.label: MerchantReturnEnumeration
types.comment: Enumerates several kinds of product return policies.

types.label: MerchantReturnPolicy
types.comment: A MerchantReturnPolicy provides information about product return policies associated with an Organization, Product, or Offer.

types.label: MerchantReturnPolicySeasonalOverride
types.comment: A seasonal override of a return policy, for example used for holidays.

types.label: Message
types.comment: A single message from a sender to one or more organizations or people.

types.label: MiddleSchool
types.comment: A middle school (typically for children aged around 11-14, although this varies somewhat).

types.label: MobileApplication
types.comment: A software application designed specifically to work well on a mobile device such as a telephone.

types.label: MobilePhoneStore
types.comment: A store that sells mobile phones and related accessories.

types.label: MolecularEntity
types.comment: Any constitutionally or isotopically distinct atom, molecule, ion, ion pair, radical, radical ion, complex, conformer etc., identifiable as a separately distinguishable entity.

types.label: MonetaryAmount
types.comment: A monetary value or range. This type can be used to describe an amount of money such as $50 USD, or a range as in describing a bank account being suitable for a balance between £1,000 and £1,000,000 GBP, or the value of a salary, etc. It is recommended to use PriceSpecification Types to describe the

types.label: MonetaryAmountDistribution
types.comment: A statistical distribution of monetary amounts.

types.label: MonetaryGrant
types.comment: A monetary grant.

types.label: MoneyTransfer
types.comment: The act of transferring money from one place to another place. This may occur electronically or physically.

types.label: MortgageLoan
types.comment: A loan in which property or real estate is used as collateral. (A loan securitized against some real estate.)

types.label: Mosque
types.comment: A mosque.

types.label: Motel
types.comment: A motel. See also the dedicated document on the use of schema.org for marking up hotels and other forms of accommodations.

types.label: Motorcycle
types.comment: A motorcycle or motorbike is a single-track, two-wheeled motor vehicle.

types.label: MotorcycleDealer
types.comment: A motorcycle dealer.

types.label: MotorcycleRepair
types.comment: A motorcycle repair shop.

types.label: MotorizedBicycle
types.comment: A motorized bicycle is a bicycle with an attached motor used to power the vehicle, or to assist with pedaling.

types.label: Mountain
types.comment: A mountain, like Mount Whitney or Mount Everest.

types.label: MoveAction
types.comment: The act of an agent relocating to a place. Related actions: TransferAction: Unlike TransferAction, the subject of the move is a living Person or Organization rather than an inanimate object.

types.label: Movie
types.comment: A movie.

types.label: MovieClip
types.comment: A short segment/part of a movie.

types.label: MovieRentalStore
types.comment: A movie rental store.

types.label: MovieSeries
types.comment: A series of movies. Included movies can be indicated with the hasPart property.

types.label: MovieTheater
types.comment: A movie theater.

types.label: MovingCompany
types.comment: A moving company.

types.label: Muscle
types.comment: A muscle is an anatomical structure consisting of a contractile form of tissue that animals use to effect movement.

types.label: Museum
types.comment: A museum.

types.label: MusicAlbum
types.comment: A collection of music tracks.

types.label: MusicAlbumProductionType
types.comment: Classification of the album by its type of content: soundtrack, live album, studio album, etc.

types.label: MusicAlbumReleaseType
types.comment: The kind of release which this album is: single, EP or album.

types.label: MusicComposition
types.comment: A musical composition.

types.label: MusicEvent
types.comment: Event type: Music event.

types.label: MusicGroup
types.comment: A musical group, such as a band, an orchestra, or a choir. Can also be a solo musician.

types.label: MusicPlaylist
types.comment: A collection of music tracks in playlist form.

types.label: MusicRecording
types.comment: A music recording (track), usually a single song.

types.label: MusicRelease
types.comment: A MusicRelease is a specific release of a music album.

types.label: MusicReleaseFormatType
types.comment: Format of this release (the type of recording media used, i.e. compact disc, digital media, LP, etc.).

types.label: MusicStore
types.comment: A music store.

types.label: MusicVenue
types.comment: A music venue.

types.label: MusicVideoObject
types.comment: A music video file.

types.label: NGO
types.comment: Organization: Non-governmental Organization.

types.label: NLNonprofitType
types.comment: NLNonprofitType: Non-profit organization type originating from the Netherlands.

types.label: NailSalon
types.comment: A nail salon.

types.label: Nerve
types.comment: A common pathway for the electrochemical nerve impulses that are transmitted along each of the axons.

types.label: NewsArticle
types.comment: A NewsArticle is an article whose content reports news, or provides background context and supporting materials for understanding the news. A more detailed overview of schema.org News markup is also available.

types.label: NewsMediaOrganization
types.comment: A News/Media organization such as a newspaper or TV station.

types.label: Newspaper
types.comment: A publication containing information about varied topics that are pertinent to general information, a geographic area, or a specific subject matter (i.e. business, culture, education). Often published daily.

types.label: NightClub
types.comment: A nightclub or discotheque.

types.label: NonprofitType
types.comment: NonprofitType enumerates several kinds of official non-profit types of which a non-profit organization can be.

types.label: Notary
types.comment: A notary.

types.label: NoteDigitalDocument
types.comment: A file containing a note, primarily for the author.

types.label: Number
types.comment: Data type: Number. Usage guidelines: Use values from 0123456789 (Unicode 'DIGIT ZERO' (U+0030) to 'DIGIT NINE' (U+0039)) rather than superficially similar Unicode symbols. Use '.' types.label: NutritionInformation
types.comment: Nutritional information about the recipe.

types.label: Observation
types.comment: Instances of the class Observation are used to specify observations about an entity at a particular time. types.label: Occupation
types.comment: A profession, may involve prolonged training and/or a formal qualification.

types.label: OccupationalExperienceRequirements
types.comment: Indicates employment-related experience requirements, e.g. monthsOfExperience.

types.label: OccupationalTherapy
types.comment: A treatment of people with physical, emotional, or social problems, using purposeful activity to help them overcome or learn to deal with their problems.

types.label: OceanBodyOfWater
types.comment: An ocean (for example, the Pacific).

types.label: Offer
types.comment: An offer to transfer some rights to an item or to provide a service — for example, an offer to sell tickets to an event, to rent the DVD of a movie, to stream a TV show over the internet, to repair a motorcycle, or to loan a book. Note: As the businessFunction property, which identifies the form of

types.label: OfferCatalog
types.comment: An OfferCatalog is an ItemList that contains related Offers and/or further OfferCatalogs that are offeredBy the same provider.

types.label: OfferForLease
types.comment: An OfferForLease in Schema.org represents an Offer to lease out something, i.e. an Offer whose businessFunction is lease out. See Good Relations for background on the underlying concepts.

types.label: OfferForPurchase
types.comment: An OfferForPurchase in Schema.org represents an Offer to sell something, i.e. an Offer whose businessFunction is sell. See Good Relations for background on the underlying concepts.

types.label: OfferItemCondition
types.comment: A list of possible conditions for the item.

types.label: OfferShippingDetails
types.comment: OfferShippingDetails represents information about shipping destinations. Multiple of these entities can be used to represent different shipping rates for different destinations: One entity for Alaska/Hawaii. A different one for continental US. A different one for all France. Multiple of these entiti

types.label: OfficeEquipmentStore
types.comment: An office equipment store.

types.label: OnDemandEvent
types.comment: A publication event, e.g. catch-up TV or radio podcast, during which a program is available on-demand.

types.label: OnlineBusiness
types.comment: A particular online business, either standalone or the online part of a broader organization. Examples include an eCommerce site, an online travel booking site, an online learning site, an online logistics and shipping provider, an online (virtual) doctor, etc.

types.label: OnlineMarketplace
types.comment: An eCommerce marketplace.

types.label: OnlineStore
types.comment: An eCommerce site.

types.label: OpeningHoursSpecification
types.comment: A structured value providing information about the opening hours of a place or a certain service inside a place. types.label: OperatingSystem
types.comment: System software that manages computer hardware and software resources, and provides common services for computer programs.

types.label: OpinionNewsArticle
types.comment: An OpinionNewsArticle is a NewsArticle that primarily expresses opinions rather than journalistic reporting of news and events. For example, a NewsArticle consisting of a column or Blog/BlogPosting entry in the Opinions section of a news publication.

types.label: Optician
types.comment: A store that sells reading glasses and similar devices for improving vision.

types.label: Order
types.comment: An order is a confirmation of a transaction (a receipt), which can contain multiple line items, each represented by an Offer that has been accepted by the customer.

types.label: OrderAction
types.comment: An agent orders an object/product/service to be delivered/sent.

types.label: OrderItem
types.comment: An order item is a line of an order. It includes the quantity and shipping details of a bought offer.

types.label: OrderStatus
types.comment: Enumerated status values for Order.

types.label: Organization
types.comment: An organization such as a school, NGO, corporation, club, etc.

types.label: OrganizationRole
types.comment: A subclass of Role used to describe roles within organizations.

types.label: OrganizeAction
types.comment: The act of manipulating/administering/supervising/controlling one or more objects.

types.label: OutletStore
types.comment: An outlet store.

types.label: OwnershipInfo
types.comment: A structured value providing information about when a certain organization or person owned a certain product.

types.label: PaintAction
types.comment: The act of producing a painting, typically with paint and canvas as instruments.

types.label: Painting
types.comment: A painting.

types.label: PalliativeProcedure
types.comment: A medical procedure intended primarily for palliative purposes, aimed at relieving the symptoms of an underlying health condition.

types.label: ParcelDelivery
types.comment: The delivery of a parcel either via the postal service or a commercial service.

types.label: ParentAudience
types.comment: A set of characteristics describing parents, who can be interested in viewing some content.

types.label: Park
types.comment: A park.

types.label: ParkingFacility
types.comment: A parking lot or other parking facility.

types.label: PathologyTest
types.comment: A medical test performed by a laboratory that typically involves examination of a tissue sample by a pathologist.

types.label: Patient
types.comment: A patient is any person recipient of health care services.

types.label: PawnShop
types.comment: A shop that will buy, or lend money against the security of, personal possessions.

types.label: PayAction
types.comment: An agent pays a price to a participant.

types.label: PaymentCard
types.comment: A payment method using a credit, debit, store or other card to associate the payment with an account.

types.label: PaymentChargeSpecification
types.comment: The costs of settling the payment using a particular payment method.

types.label: PaymentMethod
types.comment: A payment method is a standardized procedure for transferring the monetary amount for a purchase. Payment methods are characterized by the legal and technical structures used, and by the organization or group carrying out the transaction. The following legacy values should be accepted: http://purl.o

types.label: PaymentMethodType
types.comment: The type of payment method, only for generic payment types, specific forms of payments, like card payment should be expressed using subclasses of PaymentMethod.

types.label: PaymentService
types.comment: A Service to transfer funds from a person or organization to a beneficiary person or organization.

types.label: PaymentStatusType
types.comment: A specific payment status. For example, PaymentDue, PaymentComplete, etc.

types.label: PeopleAudience
types.comment: A set of characteristics belonging to people, e.g. who compose an item's target audience.

types.label: PerformAction
types.comment: The act of participating in performance arts.

types.label: PerformanceRole
types.comment: A PerformanceRole is a Role that some entity places with regard to a theatrical performance, e.g. in a Movie, TVSeries etc.

types.label: PerformingArtsEvent
types.comment: Live performance Event of the performing arts (music, theatre, dance, acrobatics, spoken word), including performance art and performative sports (e.g. choreographed forms of martial arts, figure skating, competitive ballroom dancing).Note: Use additionalType to differentiate between productions / s

types.label: PerformingArtsTheater
types.comment: A theater or other performing art center.

types.label: PerformingGroup
types.comment: A performance group, such as a band, an orchestra, or a circus.

types.label: Periodical
types.comment: A publication in any medium issued in successive parts bearing numerical or chronological designations and intended to continue indefinitely, such as a magazine, scholarly journal, or newspaper. See also blog post.

types.label: Permit
types.comment: A permit issued by an organization, e.g. a parking pass.

types.label: Person
types.comment: A person (alive, dead, undead, or fictional).

types.label: PetStore
types.comment: A pet store.

types.label: Pharmacy
types.comment: A pharmacy or drugstore.

types.label: Photograph
types.comment: A photograph.

types.label: PhotographAction
types.comment: The act of capturing still images of objects using a camera.

types.label: PhysicalActivity
types.comment: Any bodily activity that enhances or maintains physical fitness and overall health and wellness. Includes activity that is part of daily living and routine, structured exercise, and exercise prescribed as part of a medical treatment or recovery plan.

types.label: PhysicalActivityCategory
types.comment: Categories of physical activity, organized by physiologic classification.

types.label: PhysicalExam
types.comment: A type of physical examination of a patient performed by a physician.

types.label: PhysicalTherapy
types.comment: A process of progressive physical care and rehabilitation aimed at improving a health condition.

types.label: Physician
types.comment: An individual physician or a physician's office considered as a MedicalOrganization.

types.label: PhysiciansOffice
types.comment: A doctor's office or clinic.

types.label: Place
types.comment: Entities that have a somewhat fixed, physical extension.

types.label: PlaceOfWorship
types.comment: Place of worship, such as a church, synagogue, or mosque.

types.label: PlanAction
types.comment: The act of planning the execution of an event/task/action/reservation/plan to a future date.

types.label: Play
types.comment: A play is a form of literature, usually consisting of dialogue between characters, intended for theatrical performance rather than just reading. Note: A performance of a Play would be a TheaterEvent or BroadcastEvent - the Play being the workPerformed.

types.label: PlayAction
types.comment: The act of playing/exercising/training/performing for enjoyment, leisure, recreation, competition or exercise. types.label: PlayGameAction
types.comment: The act of playing a video game.

types.label: Playground
types.comment: A playground.

types.label: Plumber
types.comment: A plumbing service.

types.label: PodcastEpisode
types.comment: A single episode of a podcast series.

types.label: PodcastSeason
types.comment: A single season of a podcast. Many podcasts do not break down into separate seasons. In that case, PodcastSeries should be used.

types.label: PodcastSeries
types.comment: A podcast is an episodic series of digital audio or video files which a user can download and listen to.
